title: Speaking — Watching a place change
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on watching a place change.

questions: Where do you usually go if you need to study or read?
Do you prefer to learn in the morning or evening?
How do you keep track of what you have learned?
What helps you get back to studying after a break?
What signs tell you that a place is changing?
Do you think you notice changes in your neighbourhood quickly?

part2.topic: Describe a place where you could see signs of both its past and its future.
part2.closing: and explain why the combination was interesting.

questions: How do developers decide which parts of an old building are worth keeping?
What can local communities do to make change benefit more residents?
How has everyday life connected with watching a place change changed for people of different ages?
